annotations.text:
Adbrella on the S23 — funny dashboard, quiet everywhere else.
Mascots: Sal the seal (your phone is sealed) and Yeti (ads can’t find you). Duolingo-style idle animation: bob, blink, wave, AD-drops bouncing off the umbrella; in the app the pair also cheers on every 100th bounce and on a new badge.
Kept from Adbrella: umbrella hero, sky-to-teal gradient, copy voice ("kept off you", "drops"), 18/28 dp radii, bottom tabs.
Changed: consumer wording everywhere (no domain counts, DNS or list names on the main surfaces), 4 tabs instead of 5, a setup card that vanishes once the phone is configured, Material You colors on device (third artboard shows a warm wallpaper). Every technical control lives under Settings › Advanced.
On the phone the palette follows the wallpaper (dynamicColorScheme). The brand blue is the fallback and the umbrella stays white, so the identity survives any wallpaper.
